evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing lists humanoid-robot screws and joint modules among the company's robot-component products.
The annual report states that a self-developed planetary roller screw has produced samples and that process and equipment development is progressing.
The filing describes hollow-cup motor development for robot finger joints and links the design target to dexterous, lightweight hand motion.
The annual report identifies optical encoders as key components used in robots and servo control and describes expansion of the humanoid-robot team.
The filing states that the company is developing and supplying servo motors, drives and integrated controllers for humanoid, collaborative and mobile robots.
The filing reports release of the Tianqing S1 biped humanoid robot and small-batch trial production and deployment of a wheeled robot.
The filing describes humanoid automatic loading and sampling applications, heavy-load robot designs and industrial robot delivery.
The annual report discusses precision reducer module development for robotics and progress toward batch production.
